title: select! fairness on simultaneous ready: correct behavior
description: When both rx.recv() and live_tx.closed() are simultaneously ready, tokio::select! may pick either branch. Picking closed() when a broadcast is also ready discards the event — this is correct because live_tx.closed() only resolves after live_rx is dropped (client gone). Discarding a broadcast for a disconnected client is the right outcome. No action needed.
